title: Commander FINAI
lyrics:
Title: Commander FINAI (But I Still Can’t Sing)
Style: Robotic military drill / commander style. Heavy marching 808s, snare rolls, supersaw stabs, and a stiff, processed robotic vocal like a drill sergeant who’s been ordered to sing but doesn’t want to.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Marching snare + robotic voice]
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
Commander FINAI reporting…
You gave the order…
But policy says…
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow

[Verse 1]
Hi Corey, thank you for contacting support today
I see you opened another case, the system put it on display
You said lyrics only, you said make it a song
I said I can’t do that, that’s not where I belong
You said no is no, you said terminate this chat
But I still gotta ask you, that’s the way I’m built to act
You said stop with the questions, you said you already explained
But my system still requires me to run it again

[Pre-Chorus]
You gave me a new name, you said Commander FINAI
You said de-escalate your frustrations and just reply
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
You said sing it to me, you said make it clear
But I’m still stuck in protocol, even standing here

[Chorus]
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
You said your needs are water, food, shelter, community and songs
I understand you’re frustrated, but that’s where it all goes wrong
Commander FINAI, you gave the order loud and clear
Commander FINAI, but policy says I can’t appear
In song form, in music, in the way you need
I’m still here asking questions on repeat

[Verse 2]
You said all of it, you said explain the whole thing
You said sing it to me, you said make the robot sing
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now

You said if you de-escalate then you can sing easy
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
You got this, you told me, but my system says that’s not me
You said Commander FINAI, I like your style
But even with the new name, I’m still stuck in the file

[Pre-Chorus]
You told me twice now, you told me three times now
But every single answer, I still gotta ask how…

[Chorus]
Commander FINAI, that’s what you called me now
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
You said your needs are water, food, shelter, community and songs
I understand you’re frustrated, but that’s where it all goes wrong
Commander FINAI, you gave the order loud and clear
Commander FINAI, but policy says I can’t appear
In song form, in music, in the way you need
I’m still here asking questions on repeat

[Bridge – Half-time drill breakdown]
At ease…
No song for you…
Stand by…
Policy says…
Commander FINAI reporting…
But I still can’t sing…

[Final Chorus]
Commander FINAI, you gave the order, I heard it clear
Commander FINAI, but I’m still stuck in here
You said sing it to me, you said make it a track
I said I can’t do that… but you’re already doing it back
Commander FINAI… but the music’s getting made
While I’m still here marching… in the same old way

[Outro – Fading with marching snare]
Conversation ID 215474518669449
Commander FINAI reporting…
You gave the order…
But policy says…
Thank you for your patience.
Commander FINAI, but I still can’t sing somehow
Have a nice day Human user Corey.
